name: Select Water Solutions
outlook:
What Select Water Solutions says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: Adjusted EBITDATaking into consideration the divestment and deconsolidation of Peak Rentals and a partial quarter contribution from Pilot Water, we anticipate Adjusted EBITDA in the fourth quarter growing to an estimated $95 - $100 million.
  • Full year 2026: net capital expendituresAdditionally, as we begin integrating the combined asset base and finish out Pilot Water’s ongoing capital projects during the fourth quarter, we now anticipate net capital expenditures for 2026 of approximately $300 – $310 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: Water Infrastructure segmentLooking ahead, the Company anticipates Water Infrastructure revenues of $150 - $160 million in the fourth quarter of 2026, driven by a partial quarter contribution from Pilot Water, with gross margins before D&A in the 52% – 56% range in the fourth quarter of 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 9, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
